content.short: Kick.io is a Cardano-based fundraising platform and a project accelerator.
content.description:
Many of the launchpads existing today favour the larger investor and leave the smaller investor with little or no allocations and often out of pocket from gas. Our mission is to provide a simplified and fairer system for all investors.

KICK token holders can gain rewards on our platform by endorsing projects. Tokens are locked during the period of endorsement but released as soon as the fund raising is over. Therefore KICK tokens can be used frequently to endorse different projects. We aim to give projects access to fast and efficient fund raising and token distribution in a fairer way.

Projects launching on KICK are able to exclusively distribute Cardano Native tokens and not face the burden of attempting to bridge in tokens from other chain at a later date. Our launch projects can enjoy the benefits of the Cardano eco-system from day 1.
